blocks.p: A loadout is a named list of what you carry. Save what you carry as a loadout, restock it before a trip, and unpack it at home. To put an item on a loadout, right-click the item and choose *Save to loadout* (Figure 29-1).

caption: Figure 29-1
Save to loadout, in the menu for a machete.

blocks.p: The loadout in use is shown in the *Loadouts* fold of the *Equipment* tab (Figure 29-2). *Restock* takes what is missing from the building you are in, by the game's own actions.

blocks.note: Loadouts are new. Please test them, and report what you find in Bug reports.

marks.text: Right-click what you carry: Save to loadout.

blocks.p: The *Loadouts* fold gives the loadout in use, the days it is packed for, and how many of its lines are on you. Its to-do lists each supply and tool, what you need and have, and where it goes.

caption: Figure 29-2
The fold, and the to-do of the loadout Supply run.

blocks.p: Above its lists the to-do gives the weights: what you wear and your gear, the supplies, and the room left for loot. When a loadout is more than you can carry, the to-do says so.

marks.text: The Loadouts fold: the loadout, the days, and ready 1 of 5, the lines already on you.
Restock takes the rest from the building you are in, by the game's own actions.
The to-do: each supply and tool, how many you need and have, and where it goes.
